messages:
ben: Quick ask — we need to lock a time for the API+SDK design review (console UX overlap). Aim: 60m, sync on API surface, SDK ergonomics, and console consent UX. I want to try a round-robin facilitator rotation so no single owner every week.

ben: Proposed slots (vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:):
1) Tue 9:00am PT / 5:00pm CET
2) Tue 4:00pm CET / 8:00am PT (same day odd)
3) Wed 11:00am PT / 7:00pm CET
4) Thu 1:00pm PT / 9:00pm CET

ben: Pre-read checklist (please add links & flag blockers):
```
- API contract doc (open PR): https://git.internal/redwood/api-proto/pulls/12
- SDK auth example + code snippet under examples/auth
- Console mockups (Figma link) and click-through flow
- Latency/throughput targets and any updated perf numbers
- Known questions: rolling deploy strategy, fallback model variants, telemetry hooks
```

kim: I can do reviewer for API contract. Prefer slot 1 or 3. I'll add perf numbers to the API doc by EOD.

priya: UX asks: need dedicated 15m for Console consent UX and examples. Slot 2 is tight for me; prefer 3 or 4. I'll attach updated figma comments before the meeting.

lucas: +1 to rotating facilitator. I can lead the first one if we pick slot 3. Also, can someone add the SDK auth sample? I can help convert to TS after the meeting.

sofia: :thumbsup: I'll be there for SDK ergonomics. Vote :three:. Small ask: add a small eval script so we can demo batching effects. Suggest `./tools/run-batch-eval --model-test small --seq-len 128` in the pre-read.

ben: good — I'll create the poll once we hit consensus. Who else needs to be looped in? @security and @sre for rollout/fallback notes?

design-bot: Poll created: https://polls.internal/redwood/xyz (options 1..4). Responses: ben(1,3), kim(1,3), priya(3,4), lucas(3), sofia(3).

kim: tagging infra: @eng-infra for autoscale/burst considerations — please skim the perf numbers after I update them.

priya: Added a short checklist item in the doc: "Consent copy variations + telemetry opt-in flows" — please review before the meeting.

lucas: If slot 3 wins, I'll prepare a 10-minute demo of the SDK auth flow and a 5-minute perf teaser (before we deep-dive). Can someone add a short note in the agenda for the demo?

ben: Agenda (draft):
- 5m quick context + goals
- 10m SDK demo (lucas)
- 15m API contract review (kim)
- 15m Console UX consent + copy (priya)
- 10m rollout/fallback & perf (sofia + eng-infra)
- 5m action items + owners (rotating facilitator)

sofia: minor tweak — swap API and SDK slots so API reviewers can react to SDK auth decisions. So: SDK demo first, API after.

ben: noted. Final ask: please add any PR links or example snippets to the thread (or drop into the doc). We should lock the slot by EOD and set the facilitator rotation list. :calendar:

kim: will update API PR with perf table and a small example payload.

priya: Figma comments added.

lucas: I'll drop the demo branch link here before lunch: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/demo/auth-quick

design-bot: Poll results after 4 hours: slot 3 (Wed 11:00am PT) wins. Facilitator for this session: lucas. Reminder: add pre-read links by 24 hours prior.

ben: sweet — setting calendar invite for Wed 11:00am PT. I'll attach agenda and mark action owners. Thanks everyone! :tada:
